title: Stake
creator: iammzee / Toyyib Muhammed
summary: MIT-licensed Rust commitment-contract source with a walletless browser simulation. A private goal is represented by a salted hash; a chosen referee decides whether the proposed locked funds return to the staker or go to a chosen recipient. A deadline and grace window determine the timeout default. The referee can lie, and the proposed on-chain amount is public. The November 14 README and creator submission describe no deployed template: the current demo runs without a wallet or network. This recording walks through the public README, referee limits and simulation scope; no third-party application or contract was executed.
cardSummary: Explore private-goal commitments, trusted referee decisions and timeout rules through a walletless simulation and reusable Rust source.
